caption: The video captures a woman dancing in a bright studio with white walls, a light wood floor, ceiling spotlights, and a large mirror wall. Seen mostly from behind, she wears a yellow-and-white striped top, a white flared mini-skirt, yellow leg warmers, and white sneakers. The mirror shows her front reflection smiling, so the same figure appears twice in the fixed frame. Her arms move from bent positions near her chest into crossing motions in front of her torso and face. They lift upward with elbows bent and fists raised beside her head. She holds that raised-arm pose as her body sways and pumps through small weight shifts. Her stance narrows from a wide leg position to feet drawn close together, then the feet part again into a wider stance, with subtle torso rotations and hair swings visible in both her and the reflection.
